test(diagnostics): a config folder the OS refuses shows on every bar drawn from its entry (brandon-unfiled-3248.fyvh) (#536)

* test(diagnostics): a config folder the OS refuses shows on every bar drawn from its entry (brandon-unfiled-3248.fyvh)

candybar-plugins-vf6g.8uk (#507) carried a refused config directory to the
indicator, but only the link-chain half was proven at a drawn bar. This
drives a refusal through the daemon's own render to the ⚠, the viewer and
the render event, over a failed load too.

* test(diagnostics): a refused watch's event holds on every attempt of every bar, and a refused retry stays deaf (brandon-unfiled-3248.fyvh)

* test(diagnostics): the refused watch clears at a drawn bar, and its failed-load event counts the load error (brandon-unfiled-3248.fyvh)

chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.174.2 [skip ci]

## [1.174.2](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.174.1...v1.174.2) (2026-11-01)

### Bug Fixes

* **daemon:** a request's timers run on its clock, and the deadline case holds them (brandon-unfiled-3248.a5k3) ([#533](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/533)) ([4814ee7](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/4814ee778a28c55a7193789772cc2d681d409ab0))
fix(proc): an abort of an ended group signals nothing (candybar-testing-0x6u.425)
fix(proc): an abort stands, and no poll outlives a settled launch (candybar-testing-0x6u.425)
fix(proc): every end of a launch leaves the holder its pipes, and a timeout reads the group first (candybar-testing-0x6u.425)
fix(proc): a launch concludes with its group and leaves the holder its pipes (candybar-testing-0x6u.425)
fix(proc): a launch ends with its group, not with whoever holds its pipes (candybar-testing-0x6u.425)
feat(site): the live bar's font size is a slider
feat(site): the live bar's font size is a control, and starts larger
feat(site): site:dev serves the live bar and reloads it on every rebuild
